rationale: Full-text review confirms that the paper contains a genuine graph-based knowledge tracing module using temporal/session interaction graphs and Gated-GNN to trace the learning process and derive student latent/mastery representations. However, the paper explicitly defines the target task as cognitive diagnosis and uses the KT module to enhance that framework. Therefore it is retained as PRIMARY_ADJACENT_METHOD rather than PRIMARY_CORE, and EC2_CD_ONLY does not apply.
